description: Phase T4 experiments: Resource cap sweep (policy × mps_level) with adversarial ordering
experiment_plan_reference: Phase T4 — Resource cap sweep (policy × mps_level)

parameters.ordering_description: Largest first → smallest last (same as Phase T3)

mps_level_descriptions.25: 25% of GPU resources per job (4 jobs can share)
mps_level_descriptions.33: 33% of GPU resources per job (3 jobs can share)
mps_level_descriptions.50: 50% of GPU resources per job (2 jobs can share)
mps_level_descriptions.100: 100% of GPU resources per job (1 job at a time, effectively isolated)

gpu_server.description: Use localhost with SSH tunnel, or set to actual server IP

expected_insights: Lower MPS levels (25, 33): Higher throughput but potential fairness issues
Higher MPS levels (50, 100): Better fairness but lower overall throughput
Optimal trade-off: Identify the MPS level that balances fairness and throughput
metrics_to_analyze: Resource utilization (active jobs per GPU over time)

related_experiments.T3: Adversarial ordering stress test (predecessor to T4)
